title: Activate your membership
intro: Use the same email address you entered at Stripe checkout. Verify that email on your Beyond Media account, then activate your membership here.
invalidLink: This activation link is missing or invalid. Open the link from your completed checkout, or contact us for help.
signInExplanation: Sign in or create an account with the email you used at checkout. We’ll check your payment when you activate.
verifyExplanation: Please verify your account email before activating. It must match the email you used at checkout.
readyExplanation: Your account email is verified. Activate below to check your checkout and link your membership to this account.
verificationSent: Verification email sent. Open its link, then return here and choose “I verified my email”.
verificationFailed: We couldn’t send the verification email. Please wait a moment and try again.
verificationStillNeeded: Your email is not verified yet. Open the link in your verification email, then check again.
verificationReady: Your email is verified. You can now activate your membership.
refreshFailed: We couldn’t refresh your email verification. Please try again, or sign out and sign in again.
signOutFailed: We couldn’t sign you out. Please try again.
useAnotherAccount: Sign out to use another account

outcomes.claimed: Your Glory Share membership is now active. Thank you for your support.
outcomes.already_claimed: This membership is already linked to your account.
outcomes.email_verification_required: Verify your account email before activating your membership.
outcomes.email_mismatch: Your account email does not match the email used at checkout. Sign out and use the matching account.
outcomes.payment_pending: Your payment is still being confirmed. Please wait a moment, then try activation again.
outcomes.payment_inactive: This checkout has no active membership to link. Contact us if you need help with your payment.
outcomes.existing_membership: Your account already has a membership or an open subscription. Manage it in your account, or contact us for help with this checkout.
outcomes.claimed_elsewhere: This checkout is already linked to another account. Contact us if you need help.
outcomes.profile_pending: Your account is still being prepared. Please wait a moment and try activation again.
outcomes.not_found: We couldn’t find an eligible checkout for this link. Check the link or contact us for help.
outcomes.authentication_required: Your sign-in needs to be refreshed. Sign out, then sign in again with the email used at checkout.
outcomes.retryable_failure: We couldn’t complete activation just now. Please try again. You do not need to pay again.
outcomes.invalid_request: This activation request is invalid. Open the original checkout link or contact us for help.
